Combined derived inventory: CC BY-SA 4.0; changes are canonicalization, frontier selection and aggregation, not original glyph authorship.
method: Disjoint radical-preserving frontier; sibling kvg:part groups merged before descent, selected cross-parent fragments reconciled glyph-wide by element+original+number afterward. Stop at one of 214 NFKC Kangxi families or terminal named group. Unselected fragments are flagged incomplete, never reclaimed from another owner. Loose paths become typed residual stroke units. Counts weight each Joyo kanji once, not reading frequency.
canonicalization_policy: Native original takes precedence over element, followed by explicit family aliases including Japanese 青→靑, 黄→黃 and 戸→戶. Bare 阝 requires left/right context; native ancestor original attributes are not inherited by children.
source_metadata_policy: Raw source attributes and positional ancestry are retained before flattening. Merged position_path is their common prefix; variant and partial mean any selected source is marked true, with disagreements retained in mixed_metadata.
semantic_field_policy: Declared color convention, not historical or semantic truth. abstract is a residual catchall for celestial, color, dimension and primitive-sign labels. Presence in semantic_alternatives flags contestability; an empty list means categorization is unresolved, not unambiguous.
